title: logo设计
description:
Mascot Logo Shape: Evolved from the letter "D," artistically modified into an abstract shape that is not the letter "D," but retains its form, with abstract and beautiful line textures, and twisted lines, creating an optical illusion that appears to be a person holding a megaphone from a distance. Color Scheme: Gold. Style: Simple, flat vector art, 2-dimensional. Texture: Beautiful line quality. Theme: Symbolic and meaningful, representing promotion or advertising.
中文解释：
这个Logo的设计灵感来源于字母“D”，经过艺术改装，形成了一个不是字母“D”的抽象形状。通过扭曲的线条和美丽的线条质感，远看产生了一种幻觉，好像有个人拿着喇叭在叫卖。整体设计简约，采用金色调，展现了二维平面艺术的魅力，富有立体感。
